chart.title: Annual net migration rate
chart.subtitle: Total number of immigrants minus the number of emigrants, per 1,000 people in the population. Positive values mean more people moved in than out.

Annual net migration rate - Sex: all - A.titleLong: Annual net migration rate - UN WPP
Annual net migration rate - Sex: all - A.descriptionShort: The number of immigrants minus the number of emigrants, per 1,000 people in the population. Positive values mean more people moved into the country than left it.
descriptionKey: Net migration is the most uncertain component of population change — flows are volatile and historical data is patchy. The UN balances country values so global net migration each year sums to zero.
Expressing migration per 1,000 people makes it comparable across countries of very different sizes.
